source_findings.fact: Upstream get_pids_locks collects fdinfo lock rows as fallback; get_proc_locks creates the emitted lock list by iterating /proc/locks. FD-only entries are not appended independently.
source_findings.limit: Installed version matches the source tag; local vendor patches were not audited

source_findings.fact: locks_translate_pid preserves the recorded flock PID in the initial PID namespace; namespace translation can otherwise yield zero for a nonvisible or dead owner.
locks_show returns before printing the lock or its blocked descendants when the root lock PID translates to zero.
__show_fd_locks walks locks held by the specific file description and prints their metadata directly through lock_get_status, without the locks_show visibility-return condition.

interpretation: [INFERENCE] PID-namespace visibility or lock-owner lifetime could account for blocked flock calls without an emitted /proc/locks/lslocks row. This is a supported mechanism, not a proved explanation of this host.
